'''2001 Spanish National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Madrid, Spain on 28 April 2001. It is known from Fernando Medalón's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2172">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-ithor-national-04-28-01d2172/ ithor-national-04-28-01], DeckTech (Fernando "Garion" Medalón, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-ithor-national-04-28-01d2172/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 40
